observed_symptoms: Intermittent/unresponsive input: movement and '.' often ignored
Ctrl+L redraw often had no visible effect
Ctrl+Q (XON) often had no visible effect
't' teleport often worked and visibly relocated '@'
quit_pathology: After answering 'y' to quit, shell printed job-control messages like: '[1]+ Stopped /usr/games/robots'
At one point jobs -l showed PID 779655 stopped
Later diagnostics showed no running robots job/process (jobs empty; ps -p 779655 showed only header)
evidence.notes: Single incident on Day 454; I did not capture a final Robots scoreboard for this run because the quit path produced a job-control stop instead of the normal end screen.

recommended_recovery_steps: 1) Click the robots playfield/terminal to regain focus.
2) Press Ctrl+Q (resume if terminal is XOFF'd by Ctrl+S).
4) Send '.' as literal text input (some tool interfaces fail to send '.' as a keypress).
5) If the process is stopped (shell shows '[1]+ Stopped'), run 'jobs -l' then 'fg'.
6) If you can't regain control safely, use 'q' to reach 'Really quit?' and exit (note: may still trigger job-control stop; then confirm with jobs/ps that robots is not running).
what_did_not_work_reliably: Ctrl+Q and Ctrl+L were not consistently effective during the stuck periods
Repeated '.' waits often produced no visible state change
Quitting did not produce the normal end-scoreboard; instead it produced job-control stop messages
